speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe when the vision loss and black spots started, and have you noticed any eye pain or redness? I also need to know your current CD4 count and viral load status.

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of AIDS and recent fungal infection, I suspect an opportunistic eye infection. REQUEST TEST: Dilated Fundus Examination.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Granular yellow-white opacities around the retinal vessels and multiple areas of dot-blot hemorrhages

speaker: Doctor
text: The fundus findings of granular yellow-white opacities and dot-blot hemorrhages are classic for Cytomegalovirus retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis
